en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a two-story corner building with a hipped roof, simple stucco façade and rectangular windows. At street level there is a shop with a sign above the entrance reading "MISSZIÓI JELLEGŰ BAZÁR". A few small trees and a lamppost line the sidewalk in front of the building; a lone person stands near the shop entrance. The surrounding area appears to be a quiet, tree-lined street in a town or city.
